name: League of LLMs (LOL)
description: LOL is a benchmark-free evaluation paradigm that organizes multiple large language models into a self-governed league for multi-round mutual evaluation, focusing on dynamic, transparent, objective, and professional criteria to mitigate limitations of existing evaluation methods.
reputation: A novel benchmark-free evaluation framework that is still emerging and has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: A novel benchmark-free evaluation paradigm rather than a traditional benchmark; focuses on mutual evaluation among LLMs.
